v.why: Adding the input-output skip gives the largest gain when it replaces an absent edge rather than an existing conv or pool on that edge (exps 11,17-20 vs 12-14).
With edge 4 absent the cell has fewer paths to the output, so a direct skip restores gradient flow and helps much more (exps 19,20).
Removing the direct skip is catastrophic when edge 4 is also missing, since node 3 is then reached only through deep or missing paths (exps 64,65).
Deleting edge 4 when edge 5 is already none removes one of the few remaining inputs to the output node, causing large drops (exps 32,34).
Without the input-output skip, adding a conv path into node 3 supplies a much-needed output signal (exps 77,79).
When edge 1 is none, node 2 depends on node 1, so deleting edge 0 disconnects nodes 1 and 2 entirely (exps 92,93,99).
A skip on edge 5 partially substitutes for the missing input-output shortcut, so it helps much more when edge 3 is none (exps 81,87 vs 82-85).
When edge 4 is absent, edge 5 is the main route from intermediate nodes to the output, so adding a conv there is far more valuable (exp 8).
With edge 1 none, node 2 otherwise receives no input, so adding edge 2 activates the whole node-2 branch (exp 50).
In cells lacking the direct skip, opening the node-1 branch with a conv creates a working input-output path and yields large gains (exp 30).

The ten hypotheses below come from the 100 measurements and from the cell's topology. Most share one mechanism: an edit matters most when the parent has few other working paths from input to output. The parent edges that control this are e3 (the direct input-to-output edge), e4, e5 and e1.

- **Adding the e3 skip:** this helps most when the parent has no e3 shortcut (experiments 11, 17–20) or when e4 is none (19, 20).
- **Removing e3:** this hurts most when e4 is also none (64, 65).
- **Removing e4:** this hurts most when e5 is none (32, 34).
- **Removing e0:** this hurts most when e1 is none (92, 93, 99), because node 2 then loses its last input.
- **e3 = none parents:** adding paths on e0, e4 or e5 gave large gains here (30, 77, 79, 81, 87), since the cell lacks its identity shortcut.
- **Other dead branches:**
  - e5 → nor_conv_3x3 with e4 = none: experiment 8 gained over 44 points on CIFAR-10.
  - e2 → nor_conv_3x3 with e1 = none: experiment 50 gained 25 points on CIFAR-10.
